sources.summary: Clusters of balloons protruded from avant-garde garments at London designer Robert Wun's Autumn Winter 2026 haute couture show, giving the impression of inflatable-laden street vendors at a funfair. Hong Kong-born Wun presented his Childsplay collection during Couture Week in Paris.
